extraction_notes: Main-paper quantitative performance is plotted in Figure 5a as Fe-mass-normalized NH3 synthesis rate; values were read approximately from the plotted symbols. Unsupported FeOOH is stated to show no detectable NH3/no activity and was not recorded as a performance entry. Supporting Information figures/tables mentioned in the paper, including TOFs and catalyst-mass-based rates, were not included in the supplied text/images and therefore were not extracted.
